sentences.en: Sorry to interrupt you. How many items altogether?
sentences.zh: 抱歉打断一下，一共有多少个项目？
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Oh, the poll had 16 items. Let me give you a few examples.
sentences.zh: 这项调查一共有十六个项目。我举几个例子。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: The second item they asked about is interesting work.
sentences.zh: 他们询问的第二项，是工作是否有趣。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: They asked how important is interesting work to you.
sentences.zh: 他们问：“工作有趣这一点，对您有多重要？”
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And again, I’m just going to tell you about how many people said it was very important.
sentences.zh: 同样，我这里只介绍有多少人认为这一点“非常重要”。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: In this case, 78% of the respondents ranked this as very important to them.
sentences.zh: 这一项中，百分之七十八的受访者认为它对自己非常重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.zh: 百分之七十八？

w.m: num.百分之七十八（复述数字表示确认）

sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Yes, 78%. This is a key point, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，百分之七十八。我觉得这是个关键。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: One often sees people working for a lot less if they enjoy their work.
sentences.zh: 我们经常看到，有些人因为喜欢自己的工作，愿意接受低得多的报酬。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: That’s true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: The fourth item they asked about was opportunity to learn new skills.
sentences.zh: 他们询问的第四项，是学习新技能的机会。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: How important is that to you?
sentences.zh: 这一点对您有多重要？
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: 68% ranked this as very important.
sentences.zh: 百分之六十八的人认为这一点非常重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And I think that goes again to the idea of interest level, personal satisfaction, and the idea that people want their work to be meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这又涉及工作的趣味程度、个人满足感，以及人们希望工作有意义这种想法。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Another item, item NO. 7, recognition from coworkers.
sentences.zh: 再来看第七项：得到同事的认可。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: 62% of the respondents said that this was very important.
sentences.zh: 百分之六十二的受访者说，这一点非常重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: It was important for them to be recognized, to be respected, and acknowledged for the work they’ve done.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，自己的工作能够获得认可、尊重和肯定，这很重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And I see recognition as a psychological benefit.
sentences.zh: 我把这种认可视为一种心理上的回报。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: There’s no monetary reward necessarily attached to it, although sometimes they could be.
sentences.zh: 这种认可不一定带来金钱奖励，不过有时候也可能会有。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: But more people are looking for the psychological reward in terms of appreciation.
sentences.zh: 但更多人寻求的是得到赏识所带来的心理回报。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: It seems to me that people value psychological reward a lot more than money.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，人们对心理回报的重视远远超过金钱。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: That’s right. At least the poll result seemed to say so.
sentences.zh: 没错，至少调查结果似乎是这样。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Now, let’s take a look at another item, NO. 14.
sentences.zh: 我们再来看第十四项。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: OK!
sentences.zh: 好！
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: NO. 14 was chances for promotion.
sentences.zh: 第十四项，是晋升机会。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: 53% said that this was very important to them.
sentences.zh: 百分之五十三的人说，这对自己非常重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: It was important to them to have opportunities for advancement, chances for promotion.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，拥有职业发展和晋升的机会十分重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: And I think this goes along with high income and recognition.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这与高收入和获得认可联系在一起。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: That’s both a psychological reward, promotion, as well as a monetary reward.
sentences.zh: 晋升既是一种心理回报，也是一种金钱回报。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Umm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: 15 is contact with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 第十五项，是与许多人接触。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Some people are very people-oriented, and 52% said that this was very important to them.
sentences.zh: 有些人非常注重人际交往，百分之五十二的人说，这一点对自己非常重要。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: So we can see workers do have a lot of things that are very important to them.
sentences.zh: 由此可见，劳动者确实有许多十分看重的东西。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Yes, but you can also see the variation in numbers.
sentences.zh: 是的，不过您也能看到这些数字之间的差异。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: But a note of caution here.
sentences.zh: 但这里要提醒大家注意一点。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: These are averages, and polls talk about averages.
sentences.zh: 这些只是平均结果，民意调查反映的是总体平均情况。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: But still I think it is important for employers to become more aware of polls like these because it might allow them to keep their workers satisfied in ways that maybe they haven’t thought of before.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我仍认为雇主应该更多了解这类调查，因为它们或许能让雇主用以前没有想到的方法，提高员工的满意度。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Yeah, OK. Thank you very much Mr. West for talking to us on the program.
sentences.zh: 好的。韦斯特先生，非常感谢您参加我们的节目，接受采访。
sentences.speaker: Interviewer

sentences.en: Pleasure.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来。
sentences.speaker: Interviewee

sentences.en: Regarding the second poll, what does Mr. West think can also reflect the idea of item NO. 2?
sentences.zh: 关于第二项调查，韦斯特先生认为还有什么也能体现第二个项目所涉及的观点？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: What can we learn from the respondents’ answers to items 2, 4 and 7 in the second poll?
sentences.zh: 从第二项调查中受访者对第二、第四和第七项的回答，可以了解到什么？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: According to Mr. West, what can offer both psychological and monetary benefits?
sentences.zh: 根据韦斯特先生的介绍，什么既能带来心理回报，也能带来金钱回报？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: How many items did Mr. West take for example regarding the second poll?
sentences.zh: 谈到第二项调查时，韦斯特先生举了几个项目作为例子？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer

sentences.en: Who is more likely to rank “contact with many people” as very important?
sentences.zh: 哪类人更可能把“与许多人接触”评为非常重要？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer
